rule.name: TestMethodNamingConvention
rule.message: Test methods should follow: method_scenario_expected (underscore segments).

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[ pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.Test') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.Test') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.RepeatedTest') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.TestFactory') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.TestTemplate') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.testng.annotations.Test') ] [not(matches(@Name, '^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*(_[a-zA-Z0-9]+)+$'))]

rule.name: NonTestMethodNamingConvention
rule.message: Non-test methods should follow normal Java lowerCamelCase (no underscores).

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[ not( pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.Test') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.Test') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.RepeatedTest') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.TestFactory') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.TestTemplate') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.testng.annotations.Test') ) ] [not(matches(@Name, '^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$'))]

rule.name: NoPackagePrivateHelperMethodsInTests
rule.message: Helper methods in tests must declare an explicit access modifier (prefer private).

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[ not( pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.Test') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.Test') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.RepeatedTest') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.TestFactory') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.TestTemplate') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.testng.annotations.Test') ) and @Public = false() and @Protected = false() and @Private = false() ]

rule.name: NoPackagePrivateNestedHelperClassesInTests
rule.message: Nested helper classes in tests must declare an explicit access modifier (prefer private).

property.name: xpath
violationSuppressXPath
property.value: .[ ( self::MethodDeclaration and (@Public = false() and @Protected = false() and @Private = false()) and ( pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.Test') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.Test') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.RepeatedTest') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.TestFactory') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.TestTemplate') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.testng.annotations.Test') ) ) or ( self::ClassDeclaration and (@Public = false() and @Protected = false() and @Private = false()) and ( .//MethodDeclaration[ pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.Test') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.Test') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.RepeatedTest') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.TestFactory') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.TestTemplate') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest') or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.testng.annotations.Test') ] ) ) ]
